findings.title: Container lacks resource requests: payments/api/api
findings.description: Resource request, limit, and current-usage analysis identified a capacity or reliability concern.
findings.recommendation: Set evidence-based CPU and memory requests so scheduling and autoscaling have reliable inputs.

findings.title: Container lacks resource limits: payments/api/api
findings.description: Resource request, limit, and current-usage analysis identified a capacity or reliability concern.
findings.recommendation: Decide explicitly whether limits are required by workload behavior and namespace policy.

findings.title: Kubernetes Metrics API data is unavailable or incomplete
findings.description: Resource request, limit, and current-usage analysis identified a capacity or reliability concern.
findings.recommendation: Install or repair Metrics Server, or provide a longer-window Prometheus source before making rightsizing changes.
